name: Anjian EX: Nüyou de Mimi
source:
Your girlfriend seems to be hiding something. Will you respect her privacy or pry into her secrets? Don't worry, though.
This is a horror dating sim with a time loop, so you can try again... and again... and again...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959530]Steam[/url]]
translation: 你的女友似乎隐瞒着什么。你会尊重她的隐私，还是窥探她的秘密？不过别担心，这是一款带有时间循环设定的恐怖恋爱模拟游戏，你可以一次又一次地重来……[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959530]Steam[/url]]
